    remaining_nanoseconds = nanoseconds % 1_000_000_000

    if tz is None:
        return datetime.time(hour=h, minute=m, second=s, microsecond=microseconds)
    else:
        naive_dt = datetime.datetime(1970, 1, 1, h, m, s, microsecond=microseconds)
        aware_dt = naive_dt.replace(tzinfo=tz)
        return aware_dt
